checks.scope: Template slots requiring another artifact's owned content are targeted.
checks.observable: Trace each required copied fact to its canonical home.
checks.consistency: Matches DP-06 and the slot-shape specialization AP-94.
checks.exceptions: Newly produced content with this template as owner is exempt.
checks.fix: A link instruction removes the copied authoritative statement.
checks.expression: Canonical home is the meaningful predicate, not section title alone.

entries.rationale: The entry remains useful if ownership is established before treating the section as a copy.

checks.scope: Verdict tables with an expected all-pass state are broadly targeted.
checks.observable: Expected steady state does not prove redundant evidence.
checks.consistency: Output economy must preserve proof of coverage.
checks.exceptions: Machine parsing is exempt but human-verifiable evidence is not.
checks.fix: One-line replacement can erase criterion-level observations.
checks.expression: All-green status is an unsuitable proxy for ceremony.

entries.rationale: Preserve distinct observations and traceability even when every result passes.

checks.scope: All headed nulls and null-confirmation checkpoints are included.
checks.observable: Empty shape is inspectable; absence and unexamined scope can differ.
checks.consistency: Omission needs the artifact's consumer-contract boundary.
checks.exceptions: Required null representation and zero-result evidence need exceptions.
checks.fix: Omit decorative emptiness while preserving required null values.
checks.expression: None is not automatically absence of useful evidence.

entries.rationale: Keep the anti-ceremony goal and state the required-schema exception.

checks.scope: Repeated checkpoint decisions are the intended subject.
checks.observable: Answer-space overlap needs semantic decision and evidence identity.
checks.consistency: Distinct binary decisions must still satisfy AP-05.
checks.exceptions: Non-overlapping answer spaces is too narrow an exception.
checks.fix: Merging by option labels alone can combine independent approvals.
checks.expression: Subsumed should mean determined decision and effects, not shared labels.

entries.rationale: Prove that the first decision determines the second before merging gates.

checks.scope: Acknowledgement-only gates are well bounded by the main Detect.
checks.observable: Effects and attestation records make the core test observable.
checks.consistency: The default-frequency tail does not establish AP-88 redundancy.
checks.exceptions: Identity-and-timestamp attestations are a useful explicit exception.
checks.fix: Message conversion fits acknowledgements; the default tail overreaches.
checks.expression: Always default describes history rather than decision independence.

entries.rationale: Keep the main acknowledgement test and remove the unsupported default-frequency inference.

checks.scope: Agent-facing template guides are the bounded subject.
checks.observable: Redundant wrappers are testable by information loss on deletion.
checks.consistency: Worked examples can contribute the missing distinction.
checks.exceptions: Operative references are exempt; instructive contrast pairs should be too.
checks.fix: Fold lessons only when the rule preserves the demonstrated boundary.
checks.expression: Ceremony should mean no operative contribution, not an example format.

entries.rationale: Qualify the Good/Bad prohibition with the same redundancy test used for nearby shapes.

checks.scope: Tracked lifecycle records are targeted without current-versus-history scope.
checks.observable: Repeated current claims can be distinguished from unique events.
checks.consistency: Historical facts do not violate one authoritative current-state home.
checks.exceptions: No exception covers required chronology or durable aggregate evidence.
checks.fix: Overwrite and delete remedies can destroy the evidence chain.
checks.expression: Append-only is a data model, not itself a smell.

entries.rationale: Constrain duplicated current state while preserving required event history.

checks.scope: Resource procedure and graph routing share one Detect.
checks.observable: Operational verbs and routing references are observable.
checks.consistency: Gate-routing migration to techniques conflicts with AP-68.
checks.exceptions: Fill vocabularies and shape rules are sensibly retained.
checks.fix: Remediation must distinguish activity control from technique work.
checks.expression: Does versus fills hides two separate destinations for moved content.

entries.rationale: Move each instruction to the layer that can own it, preserving bindings and anchors.
